# Publish the one-Body five-Mask journey

Issue #4807 asks for a real user journey in which one Body spans a Linux owner, a Chromium browser, and a QEMU ConduitOS guest, while a person changes the clock and the available Masks. This PR supplies the shared Face/Mask path, screen-free Birth and operation, direct and model-assisted spoken Masks, and an eight-chapter page with current screenshots, terminal captures, and playable WAVs.

The retained run was produced at source `9b79486146bfb0af3369f8133a81b3d14792bd1c`. It completed nonvisual Birth, admitted three live hosts to one Body, changed the clock from native, browser, and terminal actions, exercised wardrobe preference and host/provider loss and recovery, and finished with screen-free Wake and Lull. The direct spoken Mask completed 11 same-Play speaker batches. A strict carrier retained 128 source-correlated outputs (about 37 MB); the Rust renderer verified the complete evidence and generated the page. CI verifies the captured source as an ancestor rather than claiming the capture was remade at the PR head.

The site selects the complete journey for `/journeys/current/one-body-five-masks/` and keeps the previous incomplete development evidence in source history. Local full-workspace Clippy, formatting, Actions syntax, all 150 preflight tests, the text-only three-host pass, focused browser/CI tests, complete evidence verification, and page rendering pass. An exact-head Candidate run is in progress. A narrow cold/warm acquisition run also passed and showed that unit acquisition caching does not beat uncached setup once restoration overhead is counted; the paired workflow now uses the cold job's actual key when runner image revisions drift.

Release and Pages acceptance are pending. QEMU and automated audio playback are not physical ConduitOS or attended human-listening evidence. This omnibus supersedes focused drafts #5178, #5179, #5184, #5185, #5191, and #5192 after integration acceptance. No issue-closing keyword is used because public release verification remains outstanding.
